```mjs
/**
 * T-060 Drop-to-Canvas — dogfood visual audit driver.
 *
 * Drives a real Chromium against the running dev server (port 3311) and
 * walks every drop path required by the Definition of Done, capturing a
 * screenshot at each step.
 *
 * The drop is performed with a genuine DataTransfer carrying a real File,
 * dispatched as dragenter/dragover/drop on the canvas element — the same
 * event stream the OS produces. Nothing is stubbed inside the app.
 */
import puppeteer from '/Users/liamellis/Desktop/apps/ultraterrestrial-resurrection/node_modules/puppeteer-core/lib/esm/puppeteer/puppeteer-core.js'
import {mkdirSync} from 'node:fs'

const EXEC = '/Users/liamellis/Library/Caches/ms-playwright/chromium-1181/chrome-mac/Chromium.app/Contents/MacOS/Chromium'
const BASE = 'http://localhost:3311/research-canvas'
const OUT = process.env.OUT_DIR
mkdirSync(OUT, {recursive: true})

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms))
const log = (...a) => console.log('[audit]', ...a)

/** Builds a File in-page and fires the real drag/drop event sequence. */
const DROP_FN = ({name, type, content, sizeBytes, clientX, clientY}) => {
  const canvas = document.querySelector('.ut-canvas')
  if (!canvas) return 'NO_CANVAS'

  const body = sizeBytes ? new Uint8Array(sizeBytes) : new TextEncoder().encode(content)
  const file = new File([body], name, {type})

  const dt = new DataTransfer()
  dt.items.add(file)

  const opts = {bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX, clientY}
  const mk = (t) => {
    const e = new DragEvent(t, opts)
    Object.defineProperty(e, 'dataTransfer', {value: dt})
    return e
  }
  canvas.dispatchEvent(mk('dragenter'))
  canvas.dispatchEvent(mk('dragover'))
  return {dispatched: true, fileSize: file.size, fileType: file.type}
}

const DRAGOVER_ONLY_FN = ({name, type, clientX, clientY}) => {
  const canvas = document.querySelector('.ut-canvas')
  const file = new File([new TextEncoder().encode('x')], name, {type})
  const dt = new DataTransfer()
  dt.items.add(file)
  const opts = {bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX, clientY}
  const mk = (t) => {
    const e = new DragEvent(t, opts)
    Object.defineProperty(e, 'dataTransfer', {value: dt})
    return e
  }
  canvas.dispatchEvent(mk('dragenter'))
  canvas.dispatchEvent(mk('dragover'))
  return true
}

const RELEASE_FN = ({name, type, content, sizeBytes, clientX, clientY}) => {
  const canvas = document.querySelector('.ut-canvas')
  const body = sizeBytes ? new Uint8Array(sizeBytes) : new TextEncoder().encode(content)
  const file = new File([body], name, {type})
  const dt = new DataTransfer()
  dt.items.add(file)
  const e = new DragEvent('drop', {bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX, clientY})
  Object.defineProperty(e, 'dataTransfer', {value: dt})
  canvas.dispatchEvent(e)
  return true
}

/** Reads back what actually rendered, so claims are evidence not vibes. */
const PROBE_FN = () => {
  const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s)
  const artifact = q('.ut-drop-artifact')
  const nodes = document.querySelectorAll('.react-flow__node')
  const edges = document.querySelectorAll('.react-flow__edge')
  const affordance = q('.ut-drop-affordance')
  const notice = q('.ut-drop-notice')
  const inspector = q('.ut-drop-inspector')
  const edgeStyles = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.react-flow__edge-path'))
    .slice(0, 12)
    .map((p) => ({
      stroke: p.style.stroke || getComputedStyle(p).stroke,
      width: p.style.strokeWidth || getComputedStyle(p).strokeWidth,
      dash: p.style.strokeDasharray || getComputedStyle(p).strokeDasharray,
    }))
  return {
    nodeCount: nodes.length,
    edgeCount: edges.length,
    artifactPresent: Boolean(artifact),
    artifactStatus: artifact?.getAttribute('data-status') ?? null,
    artifactText: artifact?.innerText?.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 400) ?? null,
    affordanceActive: affordance?.getAttribute('data-active') ?? null,
    affordanceRejected: affordance?.getAttribute('data-rejected') ?? null,
    affordanceText: affordance?.innerText?.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() ?? null,
    noticeText: notice?.innerText?.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() ?? null,
    inspectorText: inspector?.innerText?.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 500) ?? null,
    edgeStyles,
  }
}

const browser = await puppeteer.launch({
  executablePath: EXEC,
  headless: 'shell',
  userDataDir: `${OUT}/profile`,
  args: ['--no-sandbox', '--force-color-profile=srgb'],
})

const results = {}

async function scenario(key, url, steps) {
  log(`--- ${key} ---`)
  const page = await browser.newPage()
  await page.setViewport({width: 1600, height: 1000, deviceScaleFactor: 1})
  const errors = []
  page.on('pageerror', (e) => errors.push(String(e).slice(0, 200)))
  page.on('console', (m) => {
    if (m.type() === 'error') errors.push(`console: ${m.text().slice(0, 200)}`)
  })
  await page.goto(url, {waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 180000})
  // Canvas mounts client-side; wait for the React Flow pane.
  await page.waitForSelector('.ut-canvas', {timeout: 180000})
  await sleep(3500)
  const out = await steps(page)
  results[key] = {...out, pageErrors: errors.slice(0, 6)}
  await page.close()
}

const shot = (page, name) =>
  page.screenshot({path: `${OUT}/${name}.png`})

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1. success
await scenario('success', `${BASE}?ut_drop_fixture=success`, async (page) => {
  await shot(page, '01-baseline')
  const pt = {clientX: 700, clientY: 480}

  await page.evaluate(DRAGOVER_ONLY_FN, {name: 'memo.txt', type: 'text/plain', ...pt})
  await sleep(400)
  const dragProbe = await page.evaluate(PROBE_FN)
  await shot(page, '02-dragover-accepted')

  await page.evaluate(RELEASE_FN, {
    name: 'roswell-memo-1947.txt',
    type: 'text/plain',
    content: 'Memorandum for the record concerning recovered material.',
    ...pt,
  })
  await sleep(900)
  const pending = await page.evaluate(PROBE_FN)
  await shot(page, '03-pending')

  await sleep(4200)
  const resolved = await page.evaluate(PROBE_FN)
  await shot(page, '04-resolved-fanout')

  // Click a match node to open the inspector.
  const clicked = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const nodes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.react-flow__node'))
    const match = nodes.find((n) => !n.querySelector('.ut-drop-artifact'))
    if (!match) return false
    const r = match.getBoundingClientRect()
    match.dispatchEvent(
      new MouseEvent('click', {
        bubbles: true,
        cancelable: true,
        clientX: r.left + r.width / 2,
        clientY: r.top + r.height / 2,
      })
    )
    return true
  })
  await sleep(800)
  const inspector = await page.evaluate(PROBE_FN)
  await shot(page, '05-inspector')

  return {dragProbe, pending, resolved, clicked, inspector}
})

// ------------------------------------------------------------ 2. empty result
await scenario('empty', `${BASE}?ut_drop_fixture=empty`, async (page) => {
  await page.evaluate(RELEASE_FN, {
    name: 'unrelated-recipe.txt',
    type: 'text/plain',
    content: 'Ingredients and method.',
    clientX: 780,
    clientY: 460,
  })
  await sleep(3400)
  const probe = await page.evaluate(PROBE_FN)
  await shot(page, '06-empty-matches')
  return {probe}
})

// -------------------------------------------------- 3. image / vision-caption
await scenario('vision-caption', `${BASE}?ut_drop_fixture=vision-caption`, async (page) => {
  await page.evaluate(RELEASE_FN, {
    name: 'mcminnville-1950.png',
    type: 'image/png',
    content: 'PNGDATA',
    clientX: 700,
    clientY: 470,
  })
  await sleep(4600)
  const probe = await page.evaluate(PROBE_FN)
  await shot(page, '07-vision-caption')

  await page.evaluate(() => {
    const nodes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.react-flow__node'))
    const match = nodes.find((n) => !n.querySelector('.ut-drop-artifact'))
    if (!match) return
    const r = match.getBoundingClientRect()
    match.dispatchEvent(
      new MouseEvent('click', {
        bubbles: true,
        cancelable: true,
        clientX: r.left + r.width / 2,
        clientY: r.top + r.height / 2,
      })
    )
  })
  await sleep(700)
  const inspector = await page.evaluate(PROBE_FN)
  await shot(page, '08-vision-caption-inspector')
  return {probe, inspector}
})

// ----------------------------------------------------------- 4. oversized
// No fixture: contract §3 is enforced client-side, so this is the real path.
await scenario('too-large', `${BASE}`, async (page) => {
  await page.evaluate(RELEASE_FN, {
    name: 'huge-scan.pdf',
    type: 'application/pdf',
    sizeBytes: 11 * 1024 * 1024,
    clientX: 700,
    clientY: 470,
  })
  await sleep(900)
  const probe = await page.evaluate(PROBE_FN)
  await shot(page, '09-too-large')
  return {probe}
})

// ------------------------------------------------------- 5. unsupported type
await scenario('unsupported', `${BASE}`, async (page) => {
  await page.evaluate(DRAGOVER_ONLY_FN, {
    name: 'clip.mp4',
    type: 'video/mp4',
    clientX: 700,
    clientY: 470,
  })
  await sleep(400)
  const dragProbe = await page.evaluate(PROBE_FN)
  await shot(page, '10-unsupported-dragover')

  await page.evaluate(RELEASE_FN, {
    name: 'clip.mp4',
    type: 'video/mp4',
    content: 'x',
    clientX: 700,
    clientY: 470,
  })
  await sleep(900)
  const probe = await page.evaluate(PROBE_FN)
  await shot(page, '11-unsupported-dropped')
  return {dragProbe, probe}
})

// ------------------------------------- 6. real route (no fixture) — auth path
await scenario('real-route', `${BASE}`, async (page) => {
  const res = await page.evaluate(async () => {
    const fd = new FormData()
    fd.append('file', new File([new TextEncoder().encode('probe')], 'probe.txt', {type: 'text/plain'}))
    const r = await fetch('/api/processing/drop', {method: 'POST', body: fd})
    return {status: r.status, contentType: r.headers.get('content-type')}
  })
  await page.evaluate(RELEASE_FN, {
    name: 'probe.txt',
    type: 'text/plain',
    content: 'probe',
    clientX: 700,
    clientY: 470,
  })
  await sleep(2500)
  const probe = await page.evaluate(PROBE_FN)
  await shot(page, '12-real-route')
  return {routeResponse: res, probe}
})

await browser.close()
console.log('\n=== RESULTS ===')
console.log(JSON.stringify(results, null, 2))
```

```text
def _build_dry_run_plan(input_path: str, upload: bool, add_to_kb: bool) -> List[str]:
    """Derive the plan from actually inspecting the input, not a static
    list - so dry-run output reflects what THIS input would really do
    (existence, PDF-vs-text, processing_queue containment, youtube-vs-web
    routed through the real is_youtube_url()).
    """
    lines: List[str] = []
    queue_url = "https://www.ultraterrestrial.app/api/workflow/processing"

    if input_path.startswith(('http://', 'https://')):
        youtube = is_youtube_url(input_path)
        lines.append(f"Input: {input_path} (detected as {'YouTube' if youtube else 'web'} URL)")
        lines.append(
            f"Would run: {'YouTube transcript extraction' if youtube else 'Web content extraction'}")
        if add_to_kb:
            lines.append("Would write: knowledge base entry + summary/metadata files "
                          "under packages/knowledge-base/")
            lines.append("Would run: entity extraction (OpenAI)")
            if youtube:
                lines.append("Would run: CocoIndex knowledge graph construction")
            else:
                lines.append("CocoIndex knowledge graph: runs internally as part of web "
                              "content extraction above, not a separate step")
            lines.append("Would write: mem0 contextual memory entries (if MEM0_API_KEY set)")
        else:
            lines.append("Knowledge base write, entity extraction, knowledge graph: "
                          "SKIPPED (--no-kb)")
        if upload:
            lines.append("Would call: OpenAI Files API upload + vector store indexing")
            lines.append(f"Would POST to QStash queue: {queue_url}")
        return lines

    path = Path(input_path)
    exists = path.exists()
    is_pdf = input_path.lower().endswith('.pdf')
    lines.append(f"Input: {input_path} (file, exists={exists}, "
                 f"type={'PDF' if is_pdf else 'text'})")
    if not exists:
        lines.append("File does not exist - a real run would fail immediately")
        return lines
```

```mjs
// Temporary T-060 dogfood helper: obtain real Clerk browser cookies so curl can
// pass the /api/processing/* gate WITHOUT weakening middleware.ts.
// Test instance only (sk_test_).
//
//   bun ./drop-session.mjs            -> creates a throwaway user, signs in via
//                                        the Frontend API, writes cookie file
//   bun ./drop-session.mjs cleanup ID -> deletes the throwaway user
//
// A Backend-API-minted session token is NOT enough: Clerk's dev-instance
// middleware ties __session to the client identified by __clerk_db_jwt, so the
// session has to be created by signing in through the Frontend API with that
// same dev-browser token.
const key = process.env.CLERK_SECRET_KEY
const pk = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY || ''
if (!key?.startsWith('sk_test_')) {
  console.error('refusing to run: CLERK_SECRET_KEY is not a test-instance key')
  process.exit(1)
}

const bapi = async (path, init = {}) => {
  const r = await fetch(`https://api.clerk.com/v1${path}`, {
    ...init,
    headers: {Authorization: `Bearer ${key}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(init.headers || {})},
  })
  const text = await r.text()
  let json
  try { json = JSON.parse(text) } catch { json = text }
  return {status: r.status, json}
}

if (process.argv[2] === 'cleanup') {
  const id = process.argv[3]
  const del = await bapi(`/users/${id}`, {method: 'DELETE'})
  console.log('delete user', id, '->', del.status)
  process.exit(0)
}

// Frontend API host is encoded in the publishable key.
const fapi = atob(pk.split('_')[2]).replace(/\$$/, '')

const stamp = Date.now()
const email = `t060-drop-dogfood-${stamp}@example.com`
const password = `T060-dogfood-${stamp}-Aa!`
const user = await bapi('/users', {
  method: 'POST',
  body: JSON.stringify({
    email_address: [email],
    username: `t060drop${stamp}`,
    phone_number: [`+1555555${String(100 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 100)).padStart(4, '0')}`],
    password,
    skip_password_checks: true,
  }),
})
if (user.status !== 200) {
  console.error('create user failed', user.status, JSON.stringify(user.json).slice(0, 400))
  process.exit(1)
}
const userId = user.json.id

const dev = await fetch(`https://${fapi}/v1/dev_browser`, {method: 'POST'})
const devJson = await dev.json()
const devJwt = devJson.token
if (!devJwt) {
  console.error('dev_browser failed', dev.status, JSON.stringify(devJson).slice(0, 300))
  console.error('cleanup with:', userId)
  process.exit(1)
}

const signIn = await fetch(`https://${fapi}/v1/client/sign_ins?__clerk_db_jwt=${devJwt}`, {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded', Origin: 'http://localhost:3311'},
  body: new URLSearchParams({strategy: 'password', identifier: email, password}),
})
const signInJson = await signIn.json()
const client = signInJson.client
const session = client?.sessions?.find((s) => s.status === 'active') || client?.sessions?.[0]
const sessionJwt = session?.last_active_token?.jwt
if (!sessionJwt) {
  console.error('sign-in failed', signIn.status, JSON.stringify(signInJson).slice(0, 600))
  console.error('cleanup with:', userId)
  process.exit(1)
}

const iat = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(sessionJwt.split('.')[1], 'base64url').toString()).iat
const cookie = `__clerk_db_jwt=${devJwt}; __client_uat=${iat}; __session=${sessionJwt}`
await Bun.write('/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-liamellis-Desktop-apps-ultraterrestrial-resurrection/42a8a443-3dab-4bd3-9fe3-bc5a0ae5e191/scratchpad/cookie.txt', cookie)
console.log(JSON.stringify({userId, sessionId: session.id, cookieFile: 'scratchpad/cookie.txt', ok: true}))
```

## Delegation — T-060 Drop-to-Canvas

Two `app-agent`s running in parallel against a contract I wrote first, because two agents with an undefined response shape guarantees rework: `docs/plans/2026-08-13-canvas-drop-ingest-contract.md`.

- **drop-ingest-server** — `POST /api/processing/drop`: extract → `embedQuery` → `searchDatabase` fan-out.
- **drop-canvas-ux** — drop target on `graph.tsx`, artifact node, edges to matches.

Three constraints I locked down before spawning, each from a grep not an assumption:

- **Read-only against the corpus.** `grep -rn "INSERT INTO" packages/db/src` → exactly one hit, `agent-inferences.ts:54`. There is no TS corpus writer; that's Python, sitting on the still-open T-048 H1 md5-vs-sha256 call. A second writer into 126k records was not something to let an agent invent.
- **Route under `/api/processing/*`.** `middleware.ts:9-11` gates that prefix and nothing else. `/api/canvas/drop` would have been public unauthenticated upload calling paid embeddings.
- **Images → text before embedding.** 1536-dim `text-embedding-3-small` is locked corpus-wide; a CLIP vector compares to nothing and the fan-out returns silent noise.

On CanvasForge — you were right, and I've retracted it from both agents. The harness flagged it as open in your editor and it described the feature almost exactly, so I treated it as the origin spec. ## Evidence

**Typecheck** — `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` in `apps/app`: exit 1, 4,570 output lines (pre-existing repo baseline), and `grep -cE "src/(app/api/processing/drop|services/processing/drop|lib/ai/vision-fallback)"` over that log returned **`0`** — zero errors in any file I wrote.

**Dogfood — real `curl` against `next dev` on :3311, through the live Clerk gate.** Auth mechanism: throwaway user via Clerk Backend API, signed in through the Frontend API with `__clerk_db_jwt`, cookies `__clerk_db_jwt` + `__client_uat` + `__session`, token re-minted before each request (Clerk session tokens live 60 seconds). `middleware.ts` was never edited.

| Case | Result |
|---|---|
| unauthenticated POST | `404`, `x-clerk-auth-reason: protect-rewrite, dev-browser-missing` — gate confirmed |
| `text/plain` (731 B) | **200**, `derivedVia: utf8`, 728 chars, `blobUrl` live, **12 matches** across `[document_chunks, documents, events, testimonies, topics]`, 9,825 ms. Top hit: `events / "Rendlesham Forest incident" / 0.01667` |
| `application/pdf` (19,189 B) | **200**, `derivedVia: pdf-parse`, 726 chars, 12 matches, 3,245 ms |
| text 21,900 chars | **200**, `extractedChars: 21898`, **`truncated: true`**, 12 matches |
| `image/png` | **422 `EXTRACT_FAILED`** — "No image-reading model is currently available…" |
| 11 MB text | **413 `TOO_LARGE`** |
| `application/zip` | **415 `UNSUPPORTED_TYPE`** |
| 2-byte text | **422 `EXTRACT_FAILED`** |
| no `file` field | **422 `EXTRACT_FAILED`** |
| Neon outage | **502 `SEARCH_FAILED`** (see below) |

**A real bug the HTTP dogfood caught that a script harness would not have.** The PDF path first returned `422 {"error":"Could not read the PDF: Object.defineProperty called on non-object"}` — webpack's transform of `pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs` breaks it at runtime. `serverExternalPackages: ["pdfjs-dist"]` fixed it; the 200 above is the post-fix run.

**A second real bug.** Two runs returned a cheerful `200 { matches: [], tablesSearched: [] }` — caused by Neon `TypeError: fetch failed / ETIMEDOUT`, which `vectorSearch` swallows per-table (`search.ts:242`). A database outage was being rendered as a research finding. The route now runs `SELECT 1` before returning an empty result and answers 502 instead; verified firing: `[drop] corpus unreachable behind an empty result: NeonDbError` → `502 {"code":"SEARCH_FAILED"}`.

## Findings beyond T-060

**1. This app is running on a revoked OpenAI key.** `apps/app/.env` and `packages/db/.env` both hold an `OPENAI_API_KEY` that returns **401** from `/v1/embeddings`; only the **root `.env`** key returns 200 with 1536 dims. Next loads `.env` from the app directory — so **the mindmap agent and Prometheus chat are both currently embedding against a dead key.** My route only worked because the dev-server launcher injected the root key.

**2. Contract §4's table examples are wrong** (both now corrected in the file): `sightings` has no `embedding` column, so it can never appear in an embedding-only fan-out; and the tables are `key_figures` / `organizations`, not `people` / `orgs`.

## Contract changes I made — please relay to Agent B

1. **§5 refined:** empty result + unreachable corpus is now **502**, not 200. `matches: []` still means what §5 says; it just only appears when true.
2. **`matches: []` is unreachable in practice.** Vector search applies no similarity floor, so the fan-out always returns its top-12 nearest neighbours however unrelated the file is. Build the empty state, but expect never to see it today.
3. **`score` is a flat band.** With no `searchTerms` there's one list to fuse, so every response runs ~`0.01667` → ~`0.01389` by rank. **Nothing magnitude-based may be built on it** — no bar widths, opacity ramps, percentages, or strong/weak thresholds.

```text
top-12 nearest neighbours no matter how unrelated the dropped file is. The

today.
```
